video_title: 2026 ORLANDO MAGIC MEDIA DAY SOUND PRESENTED BY ADVENTHEALTH

quotes.speaker: Jeff Weltman
quotes.text: We have in the last three years been top 10 in the league in regular season wins, top four in the Eastern Conference, top three in the Eastern Conference versus top 10 teams. Our core group has posted elite numbers both in the regular season and in the playoffs. And to me is what makes all this interesting is they've done it while being one of the youngest teams in the league.
quotes.pull_quote: Our core group has posted elite numbers both in the regular season and in the playoffs.
quotes.news_angle: Jeff Weltman highlights the Orlando Magic's elite performance and youth as key indicators of success.
quotes.social_post: Jeff Weltman notes that the Orlando Magic's core group has posted elite numbers in the regular season and playoffs while remaining one of the youngest teams in the league.

quotes.speaker: Franz Wagner
quotes.text: I think it's a work in progress. I spent three weeks now here in Orlando, so it's definitely a little weird being alone at the house and coming to work alone and stuff like that. Obviously, it's bittersweet. I love playing with my brother. We shared a lot of cool memories here in Orlando together. At the same time, I'm very aware that five years is a super long time to play with your brother in the NBA, so I'm super grateful for everybody that was making that possible.
quotes.pull_quote: I love playing with my brother. We shared a lot of cool memories here in Orlando together.
quotes.news_angle: Franz Wagner discusses the transition to playing without his brother Moritz Wagner in Orlando.
quotes.social_post: Franz Wagner reflects on the change of playing without his brother Moritz in Orlando this season. He says it is bittersweet but he is super grateful for the time they had together on the team.

quotes.speaker: Jonathan Isaac
quotes.text: It means everything. I love this team, I love this city. I feel like it goes a bit deeper for me just being with the Magic for so long and the things that I've had to endure, but also what the Magic fans and the Magic organization I've had to endure alongside me. So I'm grateful, and I'm hoping to to be able to continue to be an asset and be effective and continue to return the favor.
quotes.pull_quote: I love this team, I love this city.
quotes.news_angle: Jonathan Isaac expresses his gratitude and commitment to the Orlando Magic organization.
quotes.social_post: Jonathan Isaac on his long tenure with the Orlando Magic. I love this team, I love this city.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.text: We want to do a great job of teaching first and foremost and establishing the standards that we have. But not just the standards, we want to have the behaviors and the actions that accompany what high standards look like. So we want to see who we are in what we do, how we talk to each other, the way we go about things. And then as we go through and teach, we want to make sure that if we miss something, we get it in and if there's something that we need to add, we get it added and ultimately keep growing as we approach October 7th, 21st, on and on and on all the way to April.
quotes.pull_quote: We want to do a great job of teaching first and foremost and establishing the standards.
quotes.news_angle: Jamahl Mosley emphasizes teaching and establishing high standards as the team prepares for the season.
quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says the team's focus for training camp is teaching and establishing high standards, with a focus on the behaviors and actions that accompany those standards.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Suggs
quotes.text: I feel amazing. I'm very healthy. It's been a great summer. Like I said, I haven't had many things interrupt my weeks, so I've gotten to put full weeks together, five days a week of body and on-court work and making sure that everything is primed and ready to go. So I'm feeling strong. I'm doing everything in my power to make sure that I'm healthy, maintaining the strength and able to withstand the season. So I think that's giving me a lot of confidence and a lot of freedom to be honest, especially these past couple weeks while we've been back here, working out, playing, and making sure that I feel good with my body and what I'm able to put out there on the court.
quotes.pull_quote: I'm feeling strong. I'm doing everything in my power to make sure that I'm healthy.
quotes.news_angle: Jalen Suggs reports that he is healthy and feeling strong heading into the season.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Suggs says he is feeling amazing and healthy heading into the new season. He has been putting in full weeks of work to ensure his body is primed and ready to go.

quotes.speaker: Nikola Vucevic
quotes.text: It feels great. I think I'll be more kind of it'll hit me a little more once we start playing and things like that. But it's been nice to be back. You know, we've kept our house here the whole time, so it was a very easy transition, familiar. I wasn't a big fan of school starting August 11th for my kids. I had to come back really early and it was hit still 170 degrees outside, so that kind of sucks.
quotes.pull_quote: It's been nice to be back.
quotes.news_angle: Nikola Vucevic discusses his return to Orlando and the transition process.
quotes.social_post: Nikola Vucevic on his return to Orlando. It has been a very easy transition.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Suggs
quotes.text: I don't really have too many individual goals, but just to showcase that all the intangible and stuff that I contribute in Osceola and into the G, just to do the same thing at this level. That's pretty much where I'm at with that and just to be good support to the team that we have whenever we need it.
quotes.pull_quote: I don't really have too many individual goals, but just to showcase that all the intangible.
quotes.news_angle: Jalen Suggs aims to bring his G League contributions to the NBA level this season.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Suggs says his goal for this season is to bring the same level of play and intangibles he showed in the G League to the NBA level.

quotes.speaker: Jett Howard
quotes.text: I think with my first memory of basketball, I always go back to my first game. It was at Montclair Rec Center. I was playing for the Montclair Mighty Midgets at four years old and that was my first ever basketball game and I got the video still, so it's super special. And then with the assistant coaches, my mom was my coach most of my life, so I've always been used to having women coaches in my life, so this is super special, super huge for the organization.
quotes.news_angle: Jett Howard reflects on his early basketball memories and the impact of having women coaches.
quotes.social_post: Jett Howard shares that his mom was his coach for most of his life, making the addition of women to the Orlando Magic coaching staff super special to him.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.text: I think last season was disappointing on all aspects, but you know, the good thing about it is that it's over and you know, we got a new new staff here, new energy in the building and I think everybody's excited, you know, and I think last season fueled everybody on the team, not just myself.
quotes.pull_quote: I think last season was disappointing on all aspects
quotes.news_angle: Paolo Banchero reflects on the disappointing previous season and expresses excitement for the new coaching staff.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero on the new energy in the building this season. I think last season fueled everybody on the team.

quotes.speaker: Paolo Banchero
quotes.text: This summer, you know, I worked a lot on just trying to get stronger. It's being able to guard, you know, bigger dudes in the post or being able to switch, whatever it might be. But yeah, I worked a lot on my floor game, just getting to the paint, being physical, touching up, making, you know, all just different type of reads, different type of shots.
quotes.pull_quote: I worked a lot on just trying to get stronger.
quotes.news_angle: Paolo Banchero focused on strength and his floor game during the offseason.
quotes.social_post: Paolo Banchero says he spent his offseason working on getting stronger to better guard bigger players and improving his floor game in the paint.

quotes.speaker: Wendell Carter Jr.
quotes.text: I think first staying injury free. I think I don't like to put names and accolades and oh we're trying to get a championship, you know, that's what we all want to do. Like that's that's the goal, but I think staying healthy gives us the best shot to get into that.
quotes.pull_quote: I think first staying injury free.
quotes.news_angle: Wendell Carter Jr. emphasizes the importance of staying healthy for the team's success.
quotes.social_post: Wendell Carter Jr. on the team's goals for the season. I think first staying injury free gives us the best shot.

quotes.speaker: Franz Wagner
quotes.text: Just being a connector, offensively and defensively, taking pride in guarding for the full possession.
quotes.pull_quote: Just being a connector, offensively and defensively, taking pride in guarding for the full possession.
quotes.news_angle: Franz Wagner defines his role as a connector on both ends of the floor.
quotes.social_post: Franz Wagner says his focus this season is being a connector on both offense and defense, and taking pride in his individual defense for the full possession.
